## Summary

What does this change do, and why?

## Related issues

Link any related issues (for example, `Closes #12`).

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or internal cleanup
- [ ] Test or CI change

## Checklist

- [ ] The change targets the `develop` branch.
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` reports no files.
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes.
- [ ] `go build ./...` passes.
- [ ] `go test ./...` passes.
- [ ] Public API or behavior changes are reflected in the README and Go doc comments.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private endpoints are included.
- [ ] No unrelated changes are included.

## Notes for reviewers

Anything a reviewer should pay particular attention to.
